title: Cosmic Triple Goddess
description: Three ethereal female figures in profile facing right, their bodies and faces covered in intricate swirling patterns and vibrant colors. They stand against a vivid cosmic background filled with colorful nebulae, galaxies, stars, and a prominent spiral galaxy.
prompt: Three women in profile facing right with lime green, magenta, and purple skin, their bodies and elaborate hair filled with intricate glowing spiral and circular patterns. They emerge from a vibrant cosmic nebula background with swirling galaxies, stars, and colorful space dust in deep blues, purples, and teals. Psychedelic surreal painting style with highly detailed linework and luminous colors.
